  Evidence of absence: The PR diff includes four hunks modifying `.claude/commands/claude-issue-pickup.md` (lines 38-44, 66-72, 75-81, 83-89) introducing the §26.I cleanup-call annotations, the keep-one-pickup update, the rename annotation in step 2.2, the arm-check-in archive annotation in step 5.3, and a new Rules bullet.
